acceptance.calibrated_suite_emitted_when: all categories are scorable and the measured ladder is monotone; otherwise calibrate writes its statistics receipt and refuses to emit a suite version, naming the reason
acceptance.category_scorable_when: every one of its executable cells is scored
acceptance.cell_reformatted_when: fewer than two items survive or more than one third is retired
acceptance.item_kept_when: the item is solvable and not saturated across the five arms, and it discriminates
acceptance.item_retired_when: zero arms pass, every arm passes, or neither the partial-credit spread nor the item-total correlation reaches its minimum

new.candidate_correctness_is_executed: a patch candidate is correct only if it passes the checker; the author's label is never the answer key
new.diagnostic_consequence_is_executed: a diagnostic label is verified only by compiling its registered consequence
new.pruning_is_receipted: a candidate or option that the checker shows also passes is removed by verify-formats and recorded in results/capability/derivation-verify-calibration.json
new.tolerant_extraction_never_invents_code: tolerance only changes which stored text is compiled; it never repairs code, and the taxonomy receipt shows it rescued no passing answer
new.visible_test_is_one_hidden_test: the visible test shown in a body or patch item is one test from that item's own hidden set, so showing it cannot leak the hidden set as a whole; the remaining hidden tests are still restored by the harness

must_establish: a measured per-item pass probability for every calibration item on five arms
a measured partial-credit spread and item-total correlation per item
the accepted, retired and reformatted cells, with a named reason for every retirement
whether the declared easy/medium/hard ladder is monotone in the measured difficulty
the measured baseline pass rate and paired-difference variance, and therefore the required n for 80% power at 10% relative, or an explicit statement that this n cannot reach it
a calibrated suite version that names the items allowed to carry a capability claim, or a refusal that names why none was emitted
must_not: change the registered T2 verdict or its thresholds
report a capability comparison between arms: calibration measures the instrument, not the arms
calibration_pass.split: calibration only; the sealed holdback is never opened

diagnostic.role: a separate instrument block, reported per category with its own item count
diagnostic.rule: an answer that names a diagnostic is verified by applying that option's registered consequence and compiling it; the metric is never pooled with executable success

does_not_change.t2_verdict: The registered T2 verdict (error_direction_not_supported), its thresholds, its KL/PC endpoint and its receipts are unchanged. This instrument redesigns the capability court; it does not re-decide T2.

body-completion.judged_by: the harness splices the body into a template that already contains the signature, compiles the crate and runs its tests
body-completion.visible: the function signature and one failing test

diagnostic-identification.arm_returns: the identifier of the diagnostic that explains the failure, or the option letter that names it
diagnostic-identification.judged_by: the harness applies that option's registered consequence and compiles and runs it; the diagnosis is verified only if the consequence resolves the failure
diagnostic-identification.pooling_rule: never pooled with executable task success and never part of the primary composite

file-replacement.judged_by: cargo test, exactly as in the v4 instrument
file-replacement.scope: the hardest tier only; this is the format the v4 suite used for every item

patch-selection.candidate_rule: every candidate is compiled; exactly one must pass, and which one is decided by cargo, never by an author label; a candidate that also passes is pruned by verify-formats and recorded in the derivation verification receipt
patch-selection.judged_by: the harness applies the chosen function definition, whole file or manifest, compiles the crate and runs its tests

ladder.hypothesis: body-completion is easier than patch-selection, which is easier than file-replacement, measured as 1 - mean pass rate per cell
ladder.per_category: every category carries the easy, medium and hard formats where the source tasks can express them; the derivation records any source that cannot support a format and the category cell size that results
ladder.verification: if the measured difficulty is not monotone in the declared order, the calibrated suite version is refused and the format or the tier mapping must be redesigned; the ladder labels are never reused as a difficulty claim

power.baseline: the measured mean item pass rate over accepted executable items, not an assumed 0.5
power.cannot_be_finalised_now: no calibration pass has run, so neither the baseline nor Var(d) exists. This registration states the formula and the source of every input and makes no n claim. The calibration receipt will carry the computed n and the shortfall per category; if the required n exceeds the available items, P14.8 remains open and the shortfall is published rather than hidden
power.formula: n_per_category = (z_{1-alpha/2} + z_power)^2 * Var(d) / (categories * (baseline * relative_effect)^2), where d is the per-item paired difference
power.required_n_reporting: the calibration receipt reports required n under both the planning and conservative variance, the items available per category, and the shortfall
power.target: 80% decision power at a 10% relative effect, two-sided 95%
power.variance: measured from the calibration pass's per-item outcome matrix, over the ten arm pairs; the median is the planning value and the maximum the conservative value

primary.decision_rule: unchanged: 10% relative improvement, paired 95% CI lower bound above zero, no category regressing by more than 0.05 absolute
primary.endpoint: category-balanced mean executable task success on the calibrated suite
primary.statement: only executable formats contribute; a verified diagnosis never contributes to this endpoint

secondary.role: descriptive only; it is recorded per item and reported per cell, and it is never substituted for the primary metric or used by the decision rule
secondary.why: partial credit rewards progress toward a solution and would otherwise let a model that fails every item but passes some assertions outrank one that solves fewer items completely

calibration.rule: used once, to fit item difficulty and discrimination. It is disjoint from the scored split and from the sealed holdback by construction.
calibration.selection_rule: sha256('selvedge-calibration-v1:calibration:<task id>') ascending, first 3 per category, from fixtures/capability/tasks

scored.items: not yet fixed: the calibration pass decides which formats and cells survive; the scored split is derived only after that decision
scored.rule: the calibrated suite version lists the accepted calibration items; the scored split is then derived from the remaining sources with the same derivation command and the same window
scored.selection_rule: the remaining 120 source tasks, derived by the same rules after calibration

sealed.rule: the P14.7 holdback is untouched, is not in the calibration split, is never read by the derivation, and is scored only through its custody gate

statistics.ladder: 1 - mean pass rate per tier, compared across the three executable formats within a category

per_cell.decision: scored when accepted >= 2 and retired fraction <= 1/3; otherwise reformatted
per_cell.statistics: item count, accepted count, retired count and fraction, mean pass rate, mean accepted pass rate

per_item.discrimination: the point-biserial correlation across arms between the item's outcome and the arm's total executable score with the item removed, reported with the caveat that five arms make it low-precision
per_item.partial_credit: the mean fraction of hidden tests passed (secondary)
per_item.pass_probability: the mean of the five arms' executable outcomes on the item
per_item.spread: the population standard deviation of the five arms' partial credit on the item

status: registered before any calibration run; no arm has been calibrated against this instrument
why: The registered T2 verdict's capability endpoint returned 0.0000 on every arm over 765 arm/item outcomes. The failure taxonomy of the stored receipts (results/CAPABILITY-FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md) shows the cause is the task format: no arm produced a compiling answer on 103 of 153 tasks and only two answers compiled at all, because the format demands complete replacement files for multi-file Rust crates. The registered power analysis assumed a 0.5 baseline and is therefore invalid. This file registers a redesigned, calibrated instrument whose item difficulty and discrimination are measured before any capability claim is made.

window.binary_equivalence: with A arms and binary outcomes, 0.10 <= pass rate <= 0.90 is the same statement as 1 <= passes <= A-1

power.variance_source: the pooled variance of per-item paired differences over the calibrated arm pairs

window.secondary_statement: partial credit is secondary, is reported per item, and never enters the primary composite or a decision rule
